content.short: OviO bridges Web2 and Web3 game economies, enabling a seamless gaming experience.
content.description: OviO creates a unified ecosystem that connects traditional Web2 games with token-based Web3 experiences, reducing fragmentation across the gaming landscape. Players can manage all their in-game assets from a single wallet, enabling a seamless and cohesive gaming journey. The platform also empowers developers of any size to publish their games and reach a broader audience. The OviO wallet is chain-agnostic, and its hybrid exchange gives gamers and studios a direct way to steer their game economies.
